# DAQP 0.7.2 (vendored)

Dual active-set QP solver by Daniel Arnström, MIT license (see `LICENSE`).
Source: the `csrc/` directory of the PyPI sdist `daqp==0.7.2`, i.e. the exact C
code inside the python `daqp` package that openarm_control 0.1.0 / mink 1.1 call
through qpsolvers on the robot. Unmodified; built by `../../CMakeLists.txt`
as the static library `daqp`.
